title: Join every graph event to its graph, recipe, and authority
narrative: Nubble loads graph events into a warehouse and cannot afford to open checkpoints to learn which graph, recipe, or authorization epoch produced a row. A multi-node run with a nested subgraph must stamp every event with the same graph id, recipe stamp, and epoch, and nested runs must point at their parent run so a flat table can rebuild per-node attempts[^obs-analytics].
implementation:
`GraphExecutor._emit` merges `graph_trace_context` (`graph_id`, `graph_goal`, `recipe_id`/`recipe_version` from the template stamp, `authorization_epoch` from the envelope, `parent_run_id` and `nest_depth` for nested runs) under each payload; explicit payload keys win. `project_node_attempt_rows` projects one fact row per run/node/attempt from node start/end events. `DecisionRecord` and `TraceEnvelope` use the same field names. Contract: `docs/requirements/event-analytics-schema.md`.

Covers: OBS-A01, OBS-A02, OBS-A03.
validation: Kind `graph_event_correlators`. Hard expects every parent-run event to carry the graph id, recipe stamp, and epoch; node events to carry `node_id`; nested-run events to carry `parent_run_id` and `nest_depth`; and node-attempt rows to project one per node.
